programme: Bachelor of Computing (Honours) in Computer Science

categories.label: Common Curriculum Requirements
categories.notes: University Level Requirements (6 pillars, 24 units) + Interdisciplinary/Cross-disciplinary courses (12 units) + Computer Ethics IS1108 (4 units). Key modules: CS1101S (Digital Literacy), ES2660 (Critique & Expression), IS1108 (Digital Ethics & Data Privacy), plus GEC/GES/GEN and a Data Literacy module (GEA1000/BT1101/ST1131/DSA1101).

categories.label: Computer Science Foundation
categories.notes: CS2101 + CS2103T together = 8 units; must be taken in the same semester. Total foundation = 36 units.

categories.label: Computer Science Breadth & Depth
categories.notes: 32 units of CS/IFS/CP-coded courses. Must include: (a) a satisfied Focus Area (3 Area Primary courses, >=1 at Level-4000+), (b) >=12 units at Level-4000+, (c) 6-12 units of Industry Experience (or CP4101 dissertation if GPA >= 4.0), (d) at most 12 units CP-coded (excluding Industry Experience).

categories.label: Industry Experience (within Breadth & Depth)
categories.notes: 6-12 units required, counted within the 32-unit Breadth & Depth total above (not additional). CP4101 dissertation may substitute if GPA >= 4.0 after 112 units completed.

categories.label: Primary Focus: Artificial Intelligence
categories.notes: 3 courses from AI Area Primaries, with at least one at Level-4000+ (CS3243/CS3244 are Level-3000; CS4243/CS4244/CS4246/CS4248 are Level-4000). Counts within the 32-unit Breadth & Depth total.

categories.label: Unrestricted Electives
categories.notes: Students without A-level/H2 Maths must include MA1301/X bridging course here.
